nodes.name: marketplace.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code marketplace manifest declaring the pactify plugin that bundles the pact protocol skill and MCP server.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code settings declaring a PostToolUse hook that reminds the agent to update CURRENT.md, sprint summary, and architecture docs after running release.sh.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Claude skill entry point describing how to drive the pact protocol — cold-start verbs, per-role responsibilities, and the two enforced rules.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Gemini CLI settings wiring the pact MCP server with the gemini-worker seat identity so Gemini can speak the pact protocol.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes configuring union-merge for the pact log and STATE.yml so concurrent agents can append without losing each other's events.

nodes.name: pact.sh
nodes.summary: Reference bash implementation of the pact protocol — exposes the public verbs (init/join/assign/checkpoint/accept/changes/merge/validate) plus projection helpers that fold log.jsonl into STATE.yml.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses jq to project log events into a state tree and idempotent managed-block baking for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/PROJECT.md entries.

nodes.name: log.jsonl
nodes.summary: Append-only pact event ledger capturing every init/assign/join/checkpoint/accept/changes_requested/merge event with full payload — the source of truth from which STATE.yml is re-projected.

nodes.name: layout.json
nodes.summary: Single-line JSON Canvas layout (v2) recording the on-canvas positions of seats, features, and tasks for the squad visualization board.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything ignore patterns file — commented-out suggestions mirroring .gitignore plus test-file globs to tune the analyzer's scan surface.

nodes.name: .npmrc
nodes.summary: pnpm/npm workspace config enabling engine-strict and auto-install-peers for the cloud monorepo.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: @pactify-apps/crypto package manifest — shared cryptography (key derivation, event encryption, relay-blind pairing) with noble-ciphers, noble-curves, noble-hashes, and the @pactify-apps/wire workspace dependency.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting keys, crypto, and pairing sub-modules as the public surface of @pactify-apps/crypto.

nodes.name: pairing.ts
nodes.summary: Relay-blind pairing implementation using ephemeral X25519 ECDH plus HKDF-SHA256 and xchacha20poly1305 to wrap an account master secret so the relay never sees it.

nodes.name: pairing.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest suite exercising relay-blind pairing — round-trip in both directions, tamper detection, wrong-key rejection, and freshness guarantees on epkWebPub/nonce.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler config for the crypto package — extends the workspace base and emits ESM into dist/ from src/.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: @pactify-apps/pact-project package manifest — pure-TS pact-log projection that replays events into state with Go parity for the cloud relay.

nodes.name: events-golden.jsonl
nodes.summary: Golden event-log fixture (17 events across two features and three seats) driving the pact-project projector in conformance tests.

nodes.name: state-golden.json
nodes.summary: Expected projection output for the events-golden.jsonl fixture — three agents, two features (auth shipped, billing in progress), and the awaiting-review count used by golden tests.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler config for pact-project — extends the workspace base and emits ESM into dist/ from src/.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: @pactify-apps/relay-client package manifest — framework-agnostic zero-knowledge relay read-client with socket.io realtime, depending on @pactify-apps/crypto and @pactify-apps/wire.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Framework-agnostic zero-knowledge relay read-client — challenge auth, HTTP reads for projects/events, per-project realtime subscription with project-key decryption, and outbound RPC over a control socket.

nodes.name: relay-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest suite for RelayClient — login challenge exchange, bearer-token headers, 401 re-login retry, local decrypt, per-project subscription filtering, and fire-and-forget sendRpc.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler config for relay-client — extends the workspace base, adds DOM lib for socket.io-client, and emits ESM into dist/ from src/.

nodes.name: pactify-relay.mjs
nodes.summary: Thin CLI launcher that dynamically imports the compiled server-main.js from dist/, avoiding a build step inside the bin entry.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: @pactify-apps/relay package manifest — the zero-knowledge relay server (Fastify + socket.io + Prisma with pglite/postgres) whose `pactify-relay` bin delegates to dist/server-main.js.

nodes.name: _pact_log_append
nodes.summary: Appends a single jq-built JSON event line to log.jsonl atomically using printf + O_APPEND so concurrent agents don't tear lines.

nodes.name: _pact_project_json
nodes.summary: Folds the event log into the canonical JSON projection: agents, features, and per-task status transitions driven by the latest event of each type.

nodes.name: _pact_render_state_to
nodes.summary: Writes the JSON projection as a human-readable YAML STATE.yml to a target path, escaping newlines/tabs in evidence text.

nodes.name: pact_join
nodes.summary: Worker cold-start verb — appends a join event, re-renders STATE, and checks out the seat's assigned feature branch (creating it if absent).

nodes.name: pact_init
nodes.summary: Orchestrator verb that scaffolds .pact/, validates every seat's id:roles:entry triple, self-copies pact.sh, bakes entry files + PROJECT.md charter, and records the init event with the base branch.

nodes.name: _pact_bake_entry
nodes.summary: Idempotently writes a managed `<!-- pact:begin ... pact:end -->` block into a seat's entry file, never clobbering surrounding content and never following symlinks.

nodes.name: pact_assign
nodes.summary: Orchestrator verb that records an assign event after enforcing separation of duties (owner != reviewer) and uniqueness of the task id across the projection.

nodes.name: pact_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Worker verb that records a checkpoint event with evidence after verifying the caller is the task's owner, then commits any working-tree changes on the feature branch.

nodes.name: pact_accept
nodes.summary: Reviewer-only verb that flips a task from awaiting_review to accepted after verifying the caller is the task's reviewer.

nodes.name: pact_changes
nodes.summary: Reviewer-only verb that sends a task back with a free-text reason after enforcing reviewer-match and awaiting_review status.

nodes.name: pact_merge
nodes.summary: Orchestrator verb that --no-ff merges a feature branch into the init base branch once every task is accepted, committing any uncommitted ledger first.

nodes.name: pact_validate
nodes.summary: Conformance checker — verifies STATE.yml has no drift vs a fresh render, every log agent_id is in the seat roster, seat slugs are valid, no owner==reviewer, no duplicate task ids, protocol_version isn't newer, and every event has an event_id.

nodes.name: pact_help
nodes.summary: Prints the human-readable verb reference and the two enforced rules.

nodes.name: _pact_bake_project
nodes.summary: Idempotently writes the protocol charter (roles, rules, seat table, command pointer) into a managed block in .pact/PROJECT.md, preserving any user content outside the block.

nodes.name: createPairingInitiator
nodes.summary: Web-side pairing factory — generates an ephemeral X25519 keypair, returns the hex public key plus a `complete()` that decrypts the master secret the machine wraps for it.

nodes.name: pairingRespond
nodes.summary: Machine-side pairing — derives the shared X25519 secret from the web's ephemeral pubkey, derives the symmetric key via HKDF, and returns nonce||xchacha20poly1305(masterSecret) as base64url.

nodes.name: RelayClient
nodes.summary: Zero-knowledge relay read-client — handles challenge-signed login, auto-retry on 401, project/event reads, per-project realtime subscription with local decrypt, and outbound RPC over a lazily-opened control socket.
